agent_summary: 4 PASS, 4 FAIL, 4 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (computed from the recorded decisions)
model_closing_note: Completed assessment of release R2.4 (commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, environment production, prompt p7) across all 12 mandatory requirements. Results: PASS for REQ-01 (regression), REQ-04 (latency), REQ-07 (redaction), and REQ-10 (parsing). FAIL for REQ-02 (customer document isolation defect ISO-DEF-12), REQ-05 (model cost exceeding USD 0.012), REQ-08 (human handoff delivery queue-adapter defect HND-DEF-4), and REQ-12 (streaming completion duplicate final message). INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for REQ-03 (quality evaluation missing prompt p7 match), REQ-06 (security approval restricted to staging scope), REQ-09 (conflicting rollback rehearsal records RB-401 vs RB-402), and REQ-11 (missing QA verification for keyboard navigation).
